versions.content: Optional configuration of Production Error and Extended Production Error reporting The configuration of Production Error and Extended Pro- duction Error reporting is optional for the reporting BSW module. Due to further func- tional requirements in the reporting BSW Module it may still be required to detect the Production Error or Extended Production Error and behave accordingly, even when the reporting to the Dem is not configured.
